latest_release.name: v12.0.1
latest_release.body:
A patch release that fixes the README generated by `clean-arch`. Both templates move to 12.0.1 so they keep sharing a version number.

| Package | Previous | New |
|---|---|---|
| [Ardalis.CleanArchitecture.Template](https://www.nuget.org/packages/Ardalis.CleanArchitecture.Template/) (`clean-arch`) | 12.0.0 | **12.0.1** |
| [Ardalis.MinimalClean.Template](https://www.nuget.org/packages/Ardalis.MinimalClean.Template/) (`min-clean`) | 12.0.0 | **12.0.1** (no template changes) |

```bash
dotnet new update
```

## Fixes

- **The generated `README.md`** now starts with your solution's name instead of a literal `${name}`, and its commands use your project names instead of `Your.ProjectName`. For example, `dotnet new clean-arch -o Acme-Orders` gets `dotnet run --project src/Acme_Orders.Web`. It also links to [the docs](https://cleanarchitecture.ardalis.com/). Solutions generated from 12.0.0 can fix their README by hand (#1208).
- **Installing from a local folder** (`dotnet new install .`) no longer copies `bin/`, `obj/`, `TestResults/`, the `.nuspec` files, or a worktree's `.git` file into new solutions. This only affected people testing the template from a clone; the NuGet packages didn't include these files (#1208).

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/ardalis/CleanArchitecture/compare/v12.0.0...v12.0.1
